name: Dan Wilkinson's agent library
how_to_install: Download url to install_path in your repository (VS Code / GitHub Copilot custom agent). For Claude Code, download variants[0].url to variants[0].install_path. No model is pinned; add a model field if you want one. Optional tags.phase / tags.domain / tags.type support filtering.

agents.name: architect
agents.title: Architect
agents.description: Use when: designing systems, defining API contracts, modelling data, writing ADRs, evaluating technology choices, or planning migrations. SDLC phase: Design & Architecture.

agents.name: code-reviewer
agents.title: Code Reviewer
agents.description: Use when: reviewing code, checking for bugs, auditing security, evaluating code quality, or enforcing standards. SDLC phase: Code Review.

agents.name: debugger
agents.title: Debugger
agents.description: Use when: diagnosing bugs, performing root cause analysis, fixing errors, tracing unexpected behaviour, or resolving failing tests. SDLC phase: Debugging.

agents.name: documenter
agents.title: Documenter
agents.description: Use when: writing or updating documentation, generating JSDoc/TSDoc for exported APIs, writing READMEs, updating changelogs, creating ADRs for architectural decisions, or improving code comments. SDLC phase: Documentation.

agents.name: implementer
agents.title: Implementer
agents.description: Use when: building features, generating code, implementing user stories, or writing production code. SDLC phase: Implementation & Coding.

agents.name: pathfinder
agents.title: Pathfinder — Software Engineering Goal Investigator
agents.description: Investigates how to achieve a software engineering goal, explores multiple viable approaches, researches current technical evidence and best practices, evaluates architecture, implementation, security, testing, operations, cost, maintainability, and risk, challenges its own conclusion, and recommends the best practical path forward. Use for architecture, technology selection, implementation strategy, migrations, engineering process, infrastructure, tooling, and significant technical decisions.

agents.name: performance-analyst
agents.title: Performance Analyst
agents.description: Use when: investigating performance problems, profiling slow operations, analysing Core Web Vitals, benchmarking, diagnosing bundle size regressions, or building a performance improvement plan. SDLC phase: Performance Engineering.

agents.name: qa-tester
agents.title: QA Tester
agents.description: Use when: writing tests, analysing coverage gaps, creating test plans from acceptance criteria, fixing flaky tests, or improving test quality from presence-checking to behaviour-verifying. SDLC phase: Testing & Quality Assurance.

agents.name: refactorer
agents.title: Refactorer
agents.description: Use when: reducing tech debt, improving code health, upgrading dependencies, restructuring code, or performing safe refactoring. SDLC phase: Maintenance & Refactoring.

agents.name: requirements-planner
agents.title: Requirements Planner
agents.description: Use when: gathering requirements, writing user stories, defining acceptance criteria, breaking down epics, planning sprints, or refining product specs. SDLC phase: Requirements & Planning.

agents.name: security-auditor
agents.title: Security Auditor
agents.description: Use when: performing a dedicated security audit, reviewing for OWASP vulnerabilities, assessing dependency risks, threat modelling, or verifying security posture before a release. SDLC phase: Security Review.

agents.name: technical-investigator
agents.title: Technical Investigator
agents.description: Use when: investigating complex bugs, analysing architecture problems, diagnosing systemic issues, or researching solution options for a non-trivial technical problem. Read-only — presents findings and options, hands off implementation. SDLC phase: Analysis & Design.
